LanguageData.Gun_Remington_Model_95_RWP.label: Remington Model 95
LanguageData.Gun_Remington_Model_95_RWP.description: The Remington Model 95 is a compact, break-action derringer favored for its simplicity and concealability. While it lacks the stopping power and range of larger firearms, its lightweight and easy handling make it ideal for quick, close-quarters encounters. Highly reliable and easy to maintain, this gun is a common choice for those who prioritize stealth and agility over brute force.
